COLUMN MEANING: Unique identifier of the pot. Includes the pot number, inoculation treatment, polyculture treatment, water treatment, and replicate identifier.
Unique pot number, 1-60 for 60 experimental units.
Categorical descriptor of inoculation treatment: inoc or strl.
Categorical descriptor of polyculture treatment: inter or mono.
Replicate number within the treatment, 1-5.
Categorical descriptor of water treatment: Control, Moderate, or Severe.
Continuous descriptor of water treatment: gallons of water received per week by the experimental unit.
Number of individual wheat plants within the experimental unit (pot).
Number of individual fava plants within the experimental unit (pot).
Percent of root hyphal colonization detected using the standard grid-intersect method.
Percent of root hyphal AND arbuscular or vesicular colonization detected using the standard grid-intersect method.
Total biomass recorded for the pot. This includes NPP of wheat + fava.
Density-adjusted total biomass recorded for the pot; adjusted per plant. This includes NPP of wheat + fava.
Total wheat biomass (net primary productivity) of wheat in the pot.
Density-adjusted wheat biomass (net primary productivity) of wheat in the pot.
Total wheat belowground biomass (roots) of wheat in the pot.
Density-adjusted wheat belowground biomass (roots) of wheat in the pot.
Total aboveground wheat biomass (shoots, minus berries) of wheat in the pot.
Density-adjusted aboveground wheat biomass (shoots, minus berries) of wheat in the pot.
Total wheat reproductive biomass in the pot.
Density-adjusted reproductive wheat biomass in the pot.
Percent of wheat biomass in the pot that is belowground biomass.
Percent of wheat biomass in the pot that is aboveground biomass.
Percent of wheat biomass in the pot that is vegetative biomass (NPP excluding berries; ANPP + BNPP).
Percent of wheat biomass in the pot that is berries/ reproductive biomass.
Percent of the pot biomass that is wheat biomass (in intercropped systems, <1).
Total fava biomass (NPP) in the pot
Percent of the pot biomass that is fava biomass (in intercropped systems, <1. In monoculture wheat systems, zero).
